definitions.explanation: A rate or proportion expressed as a fraction of 100. The formal mathematical term for percentage.

examples.japanese: {百分率|ひゃくぶんりつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{表|あらわ}す→表す：01868_arawasu⟧。
{合格率|ごうかくりつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{百分率|ひゃくぶんりつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{換算|かんさん}→換算：07992_kansan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To convert the pass rate into a percentage.

examples.japanese: ⟦{小学校|しょうがっこう}→小学校：01055_shougakkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{算数|さんすう}→算数：04170_sansuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{百分率|ひゃくぶんりつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{計算|けいさん}→計算：02697_keisan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{習|なら}う→習う：00479_narau⟧。
examples.english: You learn percentage calculations in elementary school math.

examples.japanese: ⟦アンケート→アンケート：03829_ankeeto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{百分率|ひゃくぶんりつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦グラフ→グラフ：04864_gurafu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦まとめた→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧。
examples.english: I summarized the survey results in a percentage graph.

notes:
Literally "hundred-part rate" — the formal Japanese term for percentage. While ⟦パーセント→パーセント：01537_paasento⟧ (percent) is the everyday word used in conversation and media, {百分率|ひゃくぶんりつ} is the term taught in mathematics education and used in formal or technical writing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {百分率|ひゃくぶんりつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{表|あらわ}す→表す：01868_arawasu⟧: to express as a percentage
- {百分率|ひゃくぶんりつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{換算|かんさん}→換算：07992_kansan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to convert to a percentage
- {百分率|ひゃくぶんりつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{計算|けいさん}→計算：02697_keisan⟧: percentage calculation
- {百分率|ひゃくぶんりつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧: percentage problems (in math)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦パーセント→パーセント：01537_paasento⟧: percent — the everyday loanword, far more common in daily use
- ⟦{割合|わりあい}→割合：01760_wariai⟧: ratio, proportion — a broader term for any ratio
- ⟦{比率|ひりつ}→比率：06727_hiritsu⟧: ratio, rate — used in comparisons between quantities
- ⟦{歩合|ぶあい}→歩合：17561_buai⟧: percentage, commission — used in business contexts like sales commission

FORMS:
⟦{百|ひゃく}→百：00780_hyaku⟧ (hundred) + ⟦{分|ぶん}→分：26216_bun⟧ (part) + ⟦{率|りつ}→率：03802_ritsu⟧ (rate).
